# 2 Kings Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 235v–237r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_015_page_001.jpg, 2KI_015_page_002.jpg, 2KI_015_page_003.jpg, 2KI_015_page_004.jpg

---

**15:1** In-the-twenty-seventh year of-Yarov'am king of-Yisra'el, reigned Azaryah [Azariah] son of-Amatsyah, king of-Yehudah.

**15:2** A-son of-sixteen years [was he] when-he-became-king, and-fifty-two years he-reigned in-Yerushalayim. And-the-name of-his-mother [was] Yekhol'yahu [Jecholiah] from-Yerushalayim.

**15:3** And-he-did the-right [ha-yashar] in-the-eyes of-YHWH, according-to-all that Amatsyah his-father had-done.

**15:4** Only the-high-places [ha-bamot] were-not removed; the-people [were] still sacrificing and-burning-incense on-the-high-places.

**15:5** And-struck [vayenagge'] YHWH the-king, and-he-was a-leper [metsora'] until the-day of-his-death, and-he-dwelt in-the-house of-freedom [beyt ha-chofshit]. And-Yotam [Jotham] the-son of-the-king [was] over the-house [al ha-bayit], judging [shofet] the-people of-the-land.

**15:6** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Azaryah and-all that he-did, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yehudah?

**15:7** And-lay-down Azaryah with-his-fathers, and-they-buried-him with-his-fathers in-the-city of-David. And-reigned Yotam his-son in-his-place.

**15:8** In-the-thirty-eighth year of-Azaryah king of-Yehudah, reigned Zekharyah [Zechariah] son of-Yarov'am over Yisra'el in-Shomron, [for] six months [shishshah chodashim].

**15:9** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH, as his-fathers had-done. He-did-not turn from the-sins of-Yarov'am son of-Nevat, who caused-Yisra'el-to-sin.

**15:10** And-conspired [vayiqshor] against-him Shallum son of-Yavesh, and-struck-him before the-people [qaval 'am] and-killed-him, and-reigned in-his-place.

**15:11** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Zekharyah, behold, they [are] written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yisra'el.

**15:12** That [was] the-word of-YHWH that he-spoke to Yehu, saying: Sons of-the-fourth [generation] [beney revi'im] shall-sit for-you upon the-throne of-Yisra'el. And-it-was so [vayehi khen].

**15:13** Shallum son of-Yavesh began-to-reign in-the-thirty-ninth year of-Uzziyah [Uzziah] king of-Yehudah, and-he-reigned a-month of-days [yereach yamim] in-Shomron.

**15:14** And-went-up Menachem [Menahem] son of-Gadi from-Tirtsah [Tirzah] and-came [to] Shomron, and-struck Shallum son of-Yavesh in-Shomron and-killed-him, and-reigned in-his-place.

**15:15** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Shallum and-his-conspiracy [qishro] that he-conspired, behold, they [are] written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yisra'el.

**15:16** Then Menachem struck Tifsach [Tiphsah] and-all who [were] in-it and-its-borders [gevuleyha] from-Tirtsah, because it-did-not open [lo fatach]; and-he-struck [it]. All its-pregnant-women [haroteyha] he-ripped-open [biqea'].

**15:17** In-the-thirty-ninth year of-Azaryah king of-Yehudah, reigned Menachem son of-Gadi over Yisra'el, [for] ten years in-Shomron.

**15:18** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH; he-did-not turn from the-sins of-Yarov'am son of-Nevat, who caused-Yisra'el-to-sin, all his-days.

**15:19** Pul [Pul] king of-Ashur [Assyria] came against the-land, and-Menachem gave to-Pul a-thousand talents [elef kikkar] of-silver, for-his-hands to-be with-him [lihyot yadav itto] to-strengthen [le-hachaziq] the-kingdom in-his-hand.

**15:20** And-brought-out [vayotse'] Menachem the-silver over Yisra'el — over all the-mighty-men of-wealth [gibborey ha-chayil] — fifty shekels of-silver for-each man [la-ish echad], to-give to-the-king of-Ashur. And-returned the-king of-Ashur and-did-not stand there in-the-land.

**15:21** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Menachem and-all that he-did, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yisra'el?

**15:22** And-lay-down Menachem with-his-fathers. And-reigned Peqachyah [Pekahiah] his-son in-his-place.

**15:23** In-the-fiftieth year of-Azaryah king of-Yehudah, reigned Peqachyah son of-Menachem over Yisra'el in-Shomron, [for] two years.

**15:24** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH; he-did-not turn from the-sins of-Yarov'am son of-Nevat, who caused-Yisra'el-to-sin.

**15:25** And-conspired against-him Peqach [Pekah] son of-Remalyahu [Remaliah], his-officer [shalish], and-struck-him in-Shomron, in-the-citadel ['armon] of-the-house of-the-king, [with] Argov and-Ar'yeh [Arieh] — and-with-him fifty men of-the-sons of-Gil'ad [Gilead]. And-he-killed-him and-reigned in-his-place.

**15:26** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Peqachyah and-all that he-did, behold, they [are] written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yisra'el.

**15:27** In-the-fifty-second year of-Azaryah king of-Yehudah, reigned Peqach son of-Remalyahu over Yisra'el in-Shomron, [for] twenty years.

**15:28** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH; he-did-not turn from the-sins of-Yarov'am son of-Nevat, who caused-Yisra'el-to-sin.

**15:29** In-the-days of-Peqach king of-Yisra'el, came Tiglat-Pil'eser [Tiglath-pileser] king of-Ashur and-took Iyyon and-Avel-Beyt-Ma'akhah [Abel-beth-maacah] and-Yanoach [Janoah] and-Qedesh [Kedesh] and-Chatsor [Hazor] and-Gil'ad and-ha-Galil [the Galilee], all the-land of-Naftali, and-exiled-them [vayaglem] to-Ashur.

**15:30** And-bound [vayiqshor] Hoshea [Hoshea] son of-Elah a-conspiracy against Peqach son of-Remalyahu, and-struck-him and-killed-him, and-reigned in-his-place, in-the-twentieth year of-Yotam son of-Uzziyah.

**15:31** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Peqach and-all that he-did, behold, they [are] written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yisra'el.

**15:32** In-the-second year of-Peqach son of-Remalyahu, king of-Yisra'el, reigned Yotam son of-Uzziyahu [Uzziah], king of-Yehudah.

**15:33** A-son of-twenty-five years [was he] when-he-became-king, and-sixteen years he-reigned in-Yerushalayim. And-the-name of-his-mother [was] Yerusha [Jerusha] daughter of-Tsadoq [Zadok].

**15:34** And-he-did the-right in-the-eyes of-YHWH; according-to-all that Uzziyahu his-father had-done, he-did.

**15:35** Only the-high-places were-not removed; the-people [were] still sacrificing and-burning-incense on-the-high-places. He built the-upper gate [sha'ar ha-'elyon] of-the-house of-YHWH.

**15:36** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Yotam and-all that he-did, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yehudah?

**15:37** In-those days YHWH began to-send [le-hashli'ach] against Yehudah Retsin [Rezin] king of-Aram and-Peqach son of-Remalyahu.

**15:38** And-lay-down Yotam with-his-fathers and-was-buried with-his-fathers in-the-city of-David his-father. And-reigned Achaz [Ahaz] his-son in-his-place.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.5 — house of freedom (beyt ha-chofshit):** A quarantine house for the leprous king. The word *chofshit* (freedom/separation) is ironic — the king is "freed" from royal duties by his disease. Jotham rules as regent, a rare co-regency arrangement.

**v.10 — before the people (qaval 'am):** Zechariah is assassinated publicly. The phrase *qaval 'am* may mean "in the presence of the people" or "in assembly." Either way, the killing is open — no secrecy, suggesting wide support for the coup.

**v.12 — sons of the fourth generation:** This note fulfills YHWH's promise to Jehu in 10:30 — four generations on the throne (Jehu, Jehoahaz, Jehoash, Jeroboam II, Zechariah). With Zechariah's assassination, the dynasty ends exactly as prophesied.

**v.16 — ripped open the pregnant women:** The brutality of Menahem's attack on Tiphsah mirrors the Aramean atrocities prophesied in 8:12. The horror is stated without comment — the narrator's silence is itself a judgment.

**v.19 — Pul king of Assyria:** Pul = Tiglath-pileser III (745–727 BCE), known by his Babylonian throne name Pul. This is Assyria's first direct intervention in Israelite affairs. Menahem pays tribute to secure his throne — becoming an Assyrian vassal.

**v.29 — the Galilee exiled:** Tiglath-pileser's campaign strips away Israel's northern and eastern territories. This is the first deportation — a preview of 722 BCE. The Galilee, Gilead, and Naphtali are absorbed into the Assyrian provincial system.

*— EMET*
